required_files.prepare.json: Private native-preparation/v1 manifest; Core api/native-preparation.example.json and api/resources/contracts/native-preparation.v1.json define the input
required_files.runtime.env: Explicit public runtime settings; use runtime.env.example
required_files.signer.seed: Base64url 32-byte dedicated Ed25519 seed, without padding; keep original for recovery
required_files.node-recipients.json: Object keyed by positive Node ID; each value has machine_id (integer or null) and recipient_sha256 (Node TLS leaf SHA-256)

optional_files.module-packages.lock.json: Exact maintainer-approved module package lock matching the immutable Core image
optional_files.modules.json: native-module-preparation/v1 ordered module operations; use modules.example.json
optional_files.module-config.CODE.json: Module configuration object; secret fields contain named secret references
optional_files.module-secrets.json: Flat secret-name to secret-value object; defaults to empty object
optional_files.outbound-policy.json: Module-code to approved HTTPS hostname array; defaults to empty object

recovery: Keep the original runner, immutable image, deployment intent, APP_KEY, backup and private inputs. Recovery resumes the original operation. It does not restore SQL, reset authority epoch or start an older image after DDL.
target_configuration: An update stages a separate target tree before draining the old process. Only module plan, module configuration, secrets, outbound policy and an already configured lock may change. Installation, Provider trust and Node bindings use their owner transition workflows. Omitting target configuration skips the initial install module plan.
